_comment: What a fresh PixOS needs before it can boot. Read over HTTP from the served repo,
not from BrowserFS, because on a first boot BrowserFS is empty.
files   copied into BrowserFS. `refresh: true` re-copies on every boot -- for the
system apps and the generated registry, which must track the served copy.
Everything else is copied only when it is missing, so local edits survive.
apps    installed from the catalog the first time only, and remembered in
/settings/preinstalled.json, so uninstalling one does not bring it back.
seed    user files, copied once and never overwritten.
defaultApps  extension -> app id, applied only to extensions with no default yet.
